short.en: Give GLPI your own look: name, favicon, logos (also per palette), colors, login page and custom CSS.

long.en: Customize what users see in GLPI without modifying any GLPI file: application name in the browser tab, favicon, main menu, collapsed menu and login page logos with a variant for dark and for light backgrounds picked automatically, logos for a single palette, drag and drop upload, main and menu colors, corners, font, login page background and frosted glass login box, a palette forced for everyone and custom CSS. Example logos in the GLPI formats are included.
